This stone door weighs hundreds of kilograms... and it only closes from the inside.
Eighty meters under Derinkuyu, in central Turkey, every level of the underground city had one.
When raiders came, families rolled the stone across the passage.
From the outside there is nothing to grab. No handle. No gap.
And the tunnels behind it are so narrow, attackers had to crawl in one by one.
How long could you hold out behind a stone door like this?
